overview_description.description: Funding Societies operates an online platform that connects individual and institutional investors with SMEs seeking loans. The platform allows SMEs to access financing quickly and efficiently, often bypassing traditional banks. The company has operations in multiple Southeast Asian countries, including Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Thailand.

about_short_description.short_description: Funding Societies is a digital finance platform that provides short-term financing to SMEs through an online marketplace.

product.name: Micro Loans
product.description: Small unsecured loans up to S$150,000 with approval and disbursement in as fast as 24 hours, intended for SMEs needing urgent financing.

product.name: Business Term Loan PRO
product.description: Medium to large term loans with tenors up to 36 months, tailored for SMEs requiring working capital or business expansion funds.

product.name: Revolving Credit Line
product.description: A flexible credit facility providing SMEs with ready access to funds up to an approved limit, allowing multiple drawdowns and repayments.

product.name: Accounts Payable (AP) Financing
product.description: Financing that allows SMEs to extend payment terms to suppliers by obtaining early payment funding for their accounts payable.

product.name: Accounts Receivable Financing (Invoice Financing)
product.description: A financing solution that converts outstanding invoices into immediate cash for SMEs, improving liquidity.

product.name: Property-Backed Secured Financing
product.description: Loans secured by property assets, allowing SMEs to borrow up to 80% of the property's value.
